properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. From the hxm_program hub's 2026-09-28 field report (art:hxm-program-feedback-2026-09-28), O-22, in the reporter's words: "Generate the file-side decision record from the node. Make `DECISIONS.md` entries and docs-graph nodes *renderings* of the Decision (or checked against it), not hand-kept copies: F-34 halved or better."

THE SAME HUB ASKED TWICE BEFORE, and neither ask was recorded as an idea until now:
· O-04, 2026-08-26: "(a) `export_markdown` — accepted decisions, enforced rules, open questions rendered as the graph's *published view*, regenerated with the export; (b) a detector — given the repo's files, which accepted/enforced nodes are referenced by none of them — so the file-side-home rule needs no local script."
· O-08, 2026-09-10: "A `DOCUMENTS`-style edge from an Artifact of type `document` to the Decision/Rule (or a `home` property) would let reflow2 itself raise 'accepted decision with no document' ... The linking half already exists (`documents`); what is missing is the gap that asks for it on accepted/enforced nodes."
The need behind all three is lesson ② of fact:lessons-from-hxm-program-the-first-reflow2-hub-for-the-hub-model-2026-09-23: "reflow2 has no concept of a reader who does not use it." Root-caused today in fact:root-cause-a-reader-who-never-runs-reflow2-has-no-served-surface-so-each-decision-is-kept-by-hand-in-three-places-2026-09-28.

OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN:
(a) RENDER. A served read, or an export option, renders the accepted decisions, enforced rules and accepted requirements into a markdown log, regenerated with the export and deterministic, as CHANGELOG is for reflow2 itself. The hand-kept entries retire. This is O-04(a).
(b) CHECK, DON'T RENDER. The project keeps writing its own file. The file is registered and linked DOCUMENTS to each Decision it holds; propagation traverses DOCUMENTS, so a revised Decision names its file entry as owed a rewrite; and, for a project that opts in, an accepted Decision that no document reaches is reported. hxm's own ratchet script becomes one read. This is O-08 and O-04(b), and the propagation half is BL-26, open in reflow2 since July.
(c) EMBED. The file stays human prose, with a rendered block per Decision between markers, diff-checked. This is option (c) of dec:idea-outward-docs-are-rendered-from-the-graph, applied to a consumer's log.
(d) A HOSTED READER. Collaborators read the design itself on a host (flo2.io) without running reflow2, so the file-side home becomes a link.
(e) NOTHING. The project's own script stays the check.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, RECORDED BESIDE IT:
· GRAIN, measured on hxm's 2026-09-23 checkout: 20 entries in its decision log against 66 accepted Decisions, of which 7 appear by id. The project also accepts a log number named in a node's text as a home. An entry bundles a decision, its progress and the affected artifacts. A one-to-one rendering would produce a different document from the one readers use, which argues for (b) or (c) over (a).
· DOCTRINE: reflow2's own rule:design-information-lives-in-the-graph-not-in-documents forbids a hand-kept log for reflow2 itself. A rendered log is a projection, which the rule permits (the CHANGELOG precedent). A consumer choosing a hand-kept one has a real reason, readers outside reflow2, that the rule was never written for.
· The project's third surface, an LLM-authored graph of its docs with its own coverage check, belongs to the project. None of these options removes it, though (a) or (b) weakens its reason.
· (d) may not be permitted: program content at a workplace facility often cannot sit on an outside host, so the file stays.
· FEWER THINGS (dec:idea-reflow2-does-fewer-things-and-does-them-really-well): (a) and (c) add an output format to maintain. (b) mostly finishes machinery reflow2 already has: DOCUMENTS, propagation, a gap.
· Size, as information: (a) medium (a renderer, plus the grain problem); (b) medium, and its propagation half would also serve reflow2's own docs; (c) medium; (d) large, and flo2 work; (e) none.
properties.name: OPEN — when a project's readers never run reflow2, should its file-side decision log be RENDERED from the design's Decisions, or CHECKED against them, instead of being a hand-kept copy that every capture pays for twice?
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill (fetched fresh) during the triage of art:hxm-program-feedback-2026-09-28. Searched first ("render decision log file from design decisions", "accepted decision with no document", O-04/O-08 by id): the nearest are reflow2's own outward-docs idea and the 09-23 lesson; O-04 and O-08 appear nowhere, so this records three sightings at once rather than duplicating a node.
